title: nan
authors: Zhou H.; Wang J.; Chen Y.; Hu L.; Li Z.; Xie F.; He J.; Wang P.
key_contribution: Presents a neural network-based SLAM/GNSS fusion localization algorithm for agricultural robots in orchard GNSS-denied environments, validated experimentally with improved positioning accuracy.

methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Deep_Learning_Odometry to ensure precise positioning.
